plain_english_summary: A debug command in Sendmail is enabled, which allows attackers to run commands with root privileges.
A vulnerability in the FTP daemon (ftpd) allows an attacker to gain root access by using the CWD ~root command.

affected_technology: passwd in BSD based operating systems 4.3 and earlier
plain_english_summary: A buffer overflow vulnerability in the 'passwd' program on BSD based operating systems version 4.3 and earlier allows a local user to gain root privileges by providing an excessively long shell or GECOS field.
A vulnerability in the 'restore' utility in SunOS versions 4.0.3 and earlier allows local users to gain elevated privileges on the system.

A security flaw in the 'rcp' command on SunOS 4.0.x allows remote attackers from trusted systems to execute any command they wish with root (administrator) privileges. This issue might be related to how the 'nobody' user is configured.
